'''DN-314 Tunneler''' was a mining droid repurposed for defense by the [[Advozse Hegemony]] on [[Hammer Station]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" /> The droid used a targeted [[Laser/Legends|laser]] during combat and could also summon demolition drones to aid it. In [[3643 BBY]], it was [[Battle for Hammer Station|destroyed]] by the strike team sent to secure the station.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The DN-314 Tunneler serves as the first boss of Flashpoint: Hammer Station in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
